svg.title: What Spead AI Pro for WIKA does
svg.desc: Tender review form: Fills the tender document review form (Lampiran 2.3) from the tender package. A person approves each item. Verified quotes: Each quote is checked against the source and marked as whole, proven, scattered, too short, partial or not found. PDF and Office reading: Reads PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, runs OCR, and splits contracts into clauses, including A/B/C structured conditions. Cited Q&A: Ask questions over a tender package. Answers carry numbered source references you can open. Knowledge library: Documents carry access rights and confidentiality labels. One filter decides what each person's assistant may read. Document Studio: Letters, minutes, reports and presentations from templates, with locked letterhead, numbering and signatures, edited in ONLYOFFICE. Connectors with approval: Connects to Microsoft 365, Google, databases, REST and MCP. Actions that change data become approval requests. SSO, 2FA and quotas: Google sign-in, TOTP two-factor login, CSRF protection, rate limits, and usage quotas per company and per person.
svg.text: The parts of Spead AI Pro for WIKA people use every day.
